1.web: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
1.asv: Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

2.web: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
2.asv: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;

3.web: He who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
3.asv: He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;

4.web: In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
4.asv: In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;

5.web: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
5.asv: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
